name: Dancing At A Wedding
overview: Scripture portrays dancing at a wedding as a joyful expression of celebration and praise, deeply rooted in God's restoration and blessing. The dancing led by Miriam after deliverance (Exodus 15:20) and the call to praise God with dance and music (Psalms 149:3; 150:4) highlight its role in worship. Additionally, the transformation from mourning to dancing (Psalms 30:11; Jeremiah 31:13) and the recognition of a proper time to dance (Ecclesiastes 3:4) emphasize that dancing at weddings is a God-ordained expression of gladness and communal rejoicing under His sovereign provision.
